source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print a single integer — the number of subsequences "QAQ" in the string.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains a string of length n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100). It's guaranteed that the string only contains uppercase English letters.
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first example there are 4 subsequences "QAQ": "QAQAQYSYIOIWIN", "QAQAQYSYIOIWIN", "QAQAQYSYIOIWIN", "QAQAQYSYIOIWIN".
